text: The Endangered Species Reserve Fund (ESRF) supports conservation and education projects to benefit endangered species in Canada and around the world. The 2020 Endangered Species Reserve Fund Budget is attached for approval.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Recommended that ESRF Projects E1 to E11 and, 12 to 33 with net expenditures of $150,000 be approved for funding from the Endangered Species Reserve Fund.
